description: Implementation of the SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) resource allocation logic for a 5G NR scheduler, including slot management, resource creation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: srs_allocator_impl
classes.description: Class responsible for managing SRS resource allocation, slot management, and configuration handling within a 5G NR scheduler.

methods.name: get_srs_symbols
methods.description: Calculates the range of OFDM symbols used for SRS based on BWP configuration and resource configuration.

methods.name: create_srs_pdu
methods.description: Generates an SRS info PDU for a given SRS resource, including configuration parameters.

methods.name: get_srs_res_grid_grant
methods.description: Creates resource grid grant information for SRS based on BWP and resource configuration.

methods.name: srs_allocator_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SRS allocator with cell configuration and optional prohibit window.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates slot information and clears previous SRS allocations for a given slot.

methods.name: allocate_aperiodic_srs
methods.description: Allocates an aperiodic SRS resource for a UE, considering slot availability and prohibit window.

methods.name: alloc_srs_resource
methods.description: Marks a specific cell resource ID as allocated in a given slot.

methods.name: get_slot_idx
methods.description: Calculates the slot index within a TDD period based on slot point.
